superseded_sentence: A late/repeated event does not replay a fresh lifeTicks22 particle sequence.
corrected_statement: A first event4, even if it arrives late relative to server time, sets clientSideAttackStarted while the unstarted client has retained lifeTicks22, so it starts a fresh local countdown and can emit particles eight subsequent client ticks later. A repeated event4 after start sets the same true flag without resetting lifeTicks; it does not restart the local countdown. This difference further prevents client particles from being a server settlement receipt.
